# Test Fixture Policy

Test fixtures must be generated by this project, recorded specifically for testing with redistribution permission, or covered by a permissive license that allows repository redistribution.

Do not commit copyrighted movie, television, podcast, audiobook, streaming-service, or other media extracts merely because they are convenient ASR samples.

Every externally sourced fixture must have adjacent provenance metadata recording its source, license, attribution requirements, and any transformations. Generated fixtures must document the generator or procedure needed to reproduce them.

Speech fixtures used for deterministic ASR acceptance should remain stable once admitted so benchmark changes reflect implementation/model changes rather than silent corpus drift.
